messages.subject: Complex programming
parts:
Good evening gentlemen!

Has complex programming and try to explain what I want through a reproducible example .

file server.R

library ( shiny )

segment_ll < - function (x, b0 , b1, b2 , X0) {
  ( b0 + b1 * x ) * ( x < = X0 ) +
  ( X0 * b0 + (b1 -b2 ) + b2 * x ) * ( x > x0 )
}

# Define server logic required to generate the plot
shinyServer (function ( input, output ) {

            datasetinput < - reactive ( {

              seq = x (1.10 )
              y = x +1.1 * 2 +0.5 * x ^ 2

              data <- data.frame (x, y)

            } )

            output $ contents < - renderTable ( {

              datasetinput ()

            } )

            # Listing the variables

            selectvarsdep output $ <- renderUI ( {

              dad < - datasetinput ( )

              if ( is.null ( dad) )
                return ( NULL )

              selectInput ( ' inVarsdep '
                          ''
                          names ( dad) )

            } )

            selectvarsindep output $ <- renderUI ( {

              dad < - datasetinput ( )

              if ( is.null ( dad) )
                return ( NULL )

              selectInput ( ' inVarsindep '
                          ''
                          names ( dad) )

            } )

            # Deslisadores linear to linear - segmented function
            slidersegllb0 output $ <- renderUI ( {
              sliderInput ( " insllb0 " , "Parameter b0 " , $ input = segll_minb0 min , max = $ segll_maxb0 input , input value = $ segll_minb0 )
            } )
            slidersegllb1 output $ <- renderUI ( {
              sliderInput ( " insllb1 " , "Parameter b1 " , $ input = segll_minb1 min , max = $ segll_maxb1 input , input value = $ segll_minb1 )
            } )
            slidersegllb2 output $ <- renderUI ( {
              sliderInput ( " insllb2 " , "Parameter b2 " , $ input = segll_minb2 min , max = $ segll_maxb2 input , input value = $ segll_minb2 )
            } )
            slidersegllX0 output $ <- renderUI ( {
              sliderInput ( " insllX0 " , "Parameter X0 " , $ input = segll_minX0 min , max = $ segll_maxX0 input , input value = $ segll_minX0 )
            } )

            # Deslisadores for your model
            output $ mins < - renderUI ( {

             expression1 < - grep ( ' [ [ : alpha: ] ] ' ,
                                 Unlist ( strsplit ( $ input yourmodel ,
                                                 ' [ [ : punct : ] ] ' ) ) ,
                                 value = T)

             expression2 < - grep ( ' x ' ,
                                 expression1
                                 value = T)

             parameters < - setdiff ( expression1 ,
                                   expression2 )

             expression3 < - paste ( paste ( ' function ( x , ' ,
                                        paste ( parameters ,
                                              collapse = ' ' )
                                        ')' ,
                                        sep ='' ) ,
                                  input $ yourmodel ,
                                  sep ='' )

             numinMin < - paste ( ' inMin '
                               parameters ,
                               sep ='' )

             cat ( paste ( paste ( ' $ output '
                             numinMin ,
                             " < - renderUI ( { NumericInput ( 'min ' ,
                             parameters ,
                             " ',' Minimum for "
                             sep ='' ) ,
                       parameters ,
                       " ' "
                       rep ( 1 , length ( parameters) ) ,
                       ' ) } ) "
                       sep = '' )
                 sep = ' \ n' )
            } )


            # Plotting the observed data
            plotDados output $ <- renderPlot ( {

              dad < - datasetinput ( )

              var_dep < - input $ inVarsdep
              var_indep < - input $ inVarsindep

              plot ( dad [ [ var_indep ] ] ,
                   dad [ [ var_dep ] ] ,
                   XLAB = var_indep ,
                   ylab = var_dep )

              # Plotanto the model on the observed data

                if (input == $ models ' segll ' ) {

                  curve ( segment_ll ( x , insllb0 $ input , $ input insllb1 , insllb2 $ input , $ input insllX0 )
                        min ( dad [ [ var_indep ] ] )
                        max ( dad [ [ var_indep ] ] )
                        T add = ,
                        col = 'red' )

                Else { }

                  seumodelo < - eval ( parse ( text = expression3 ( ) ) )

                }

            } )
} )
 
file ui.R

library ( shiny )

# Define UI for dataset viewer application
shinyUI ( pageWithSidebar (
                        headerPanel ( ' Find the kicks of your initial nonlinear model ' ) ,

                        sidebarPanel (

                                           wellPanel (
                                               p ( strong ( 'Select one of the functions below ' ) ) ,
                                               selectInput ( ' models ' ,
                                                           ''
                                                           c ( ' segll ' ' -linear segmented linear ' = ,
                                                             'Other' = 'other' ) ) ,

                                               # Show only when the model is another
                                               conditionalPanel (
                                                                condition = " input.modelos == 'other '"
                                                                textInput ( ' yourmodel '
                                                                          ''
                                                                          'a + b * x ' ) )
                                               )

                                     wellPanel (
                                               p ( strong ( 'Select the dependent variable ' ) ) ,
                                               UIOutput ( ' selectvarsdep ')) ,

                                     wellPanel (
                                               p ( strong ( 'Select the independent variable ' ) ) ,
                                               UIOutput ( ' selectvarsindep ')) ,

                                     wellPanel (
                                               p ( strong ( ' Enter the limits (minimum and maximum) of the parameters' ) ) ,
                                               
                                               conditionalPanel (
                                                                condition = " input.modelos == ' segll '"
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_minb0 '
                                                                             " Minimum to b0 '
                                                                             1)
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_maxb0 '
                                                                             ' Maximum to b0 '
                                                                             4)
                                                                UIOutput ( ' slidersegllb0 ' ) ,
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_minb1 '
                                                                             ' Minimum for b1 '
                                                                             0.1 ) ,
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_maxb1 '
                                                                             ' Maximum for b1 '
                                                                             0.8 )
                                                                UIOutput ( ' slidersegllb1 ' ) ,
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_minb2 '
                                                                             ' Minimum for b2 '
                                                                             10)
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_maxb2 '
                                                                             ' Maximum for b2 '
                                                                             20)
                                                                UIOutput ( ' slidersegllb2 ' ) ,
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_minX0 '
                                                                             ' Minimum for X0 '
                                                                             10)
                                                                NumericInput ( ' segll_maxX0 '
                                                                             ' Maximum for X0 '
                                                                             20)
                                                                UIOutput ( ' slidersegllX0 ')) ,

                                               conditionalPanel (
                                                                condition = " input.modelos == 'other '"
                                                                UIOutput ( ' days ' )
                                                                )
                                               )
                                     )

                        mainPanel (
                                  tabsetPanel (
                                              TabPanel ( 'Data' , tableOutput ( ' contents' ) ) ,
                                              TabPanel ( ' graph ' , plotOutput ( ' plotDados '
                                                                             width = '900px '
                                                                             height = '700px ' ) )
                                              ) )
                        ) )

I would like to create the same panels whatever the role of the person placing . I know it's kind of complex , so ask the experts if it is possible what I want to do.

See you soon!
